# AI Act classification: picket-forest 0.2.0

Not legal advice. Classification by the provider under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, references checked 2026-10-11 (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by the digital omnibus (in force 2026-07-27)).

- **AI system (Art. 3(1)):** yes. The weights (a random forest) are published together with the feature, decision and alarm code for microcontrollers, so the release is usable as a machine-based system that infers alarms from CAN frames (Art. 3(1)).
- **General-purpose AI model (Art. 3(63)):** no. A small task-specific detector for CAN intrusion detection; it does not generate content and is not capable of a wide range of distinct tasks; compute many orders of magnitude below the indicative 10^23 FLOP of the Commission GPAI guidelines (July 2025). Parameters: 20,000. Estimated training compute: 1000000000000.0 FLOP (fine-tuning; method: Own upper estimate: a random forest of at most 30 trees on about 2 million subsampled frames with 10 features; tree nodes of the release model are listed in config.json. No base model.); base model: unknown FLOP. Indicative threshold of the Commission guidelines: 10^23 FLOP and generative capability.
- **Open-source exclusion:** art2_12; monetisation: none.
- **Intended purpose:** Research, teaching and bench testing of intrusion detection on classic CAN buses: after a calibration on benign traffic of one vehicle, the detector flags frames that exceed the calibrated frame counts, unknown-identifier bursts (fuzzing) and DLC changes, and raises alarms for an IDS manager or a log. Status: experimental, not production ready.
- **Out of scope:**
  - Deployment in vehicles on public roads as a safety or security mechanism; any ISO/SAE 21434 or UNECE R155 claim; active countermeasures (blocking or injecting frames) based on its output; identifying drivers or tracking vehicles; CAN FD and automotive Ethernet.
- **High-risk (Annex III):** none (no use in biometrics, critical infrastructure management, employment, education, essential services, law enforcement, migration or justice is intended). **Annex I / safety component:** none; safety component: no. A research and monitoring tool on a test bench; not placed on the market as a component of a vehicle under Regulation (EU) 2018/858 or 2019/2144 and not a safety component; vehicle integration would need its own type-approval and cybersecurity process.
- **Transparency obligations (Art. 50):** none (no interaction with natural persons, no generated content).
- **Export control:** not listed (Regulation (EU) 2021/821, Annex I). A defensive anomaly detector for in-vehicle CAN buses; no cryptography, no intrusion software, not an IP network surveillance system (5A001.j concerns IP networks). Dual-use note on the card - the published features and thresholds also tell an attacker what is detected.
- **Guidelines used:** Commission guidelines on the definition of an AI system (Feb 2025); Commission guidelines on general-purpose AI models (July 2025).
